chapter_title_en: The Mentality of the Great Tribulation
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0541 – Crimsonbright’s Ruthless War Lesson Changes the Xia Emperor
chapter_meta_description: Daofather Crimsonbright teaches the Xia Emperor the brutal arithmetic of the Great Tribulation. Ji Ning shifts the war’s balance, forcing the Seamless Gate to consider a shameful retreat.
og_title: The Great Tribulation Demands Ruthlessness – Desolate Era Ch. 0541
og_description: A Daofather's harsh lesson, a victory that shifts the war, and a Seamless Gate forced to beg for reinforcements—this chapter is a turning point.
twitter_title: Ji Ning Kills a Pure Yang True Immortal – War Turns
twitter_description: Daofather Crimsonbright admits his error. The Xia Emperor learns to be ruthless. The Seamless Gate panics. Reading Desolate Era 0541.

lore_anchors.definition: A supreme True God Daofather governing the Crimsonbright Realm, one of the highest authorities in the Nuwa Camp; he is Ji Ning’s indirect superior in the war against the Seamless Gate.
A major realm under Daofather Jiuyang, comparable in scale and power to the Crimsonbright Realm; its war against the Seamless Gate is far more brutal than the Grand Xia conflict.
A powerful battle formation used by a group of True Immortals that can approach the destructive power of a Daofather.
A True Immortal who has successfully refined the five elemental Daos, fully transforming their Golden Core into Pure Yang; a major power threshold and a rare asset in the war.
A suicidal Seamless Gate war asset that trades its own destruction for a devastating kill against the enemy.
The Xia Emperor’s ultimate defensive formation; activating it consumes massive amounts of Golden Core Source, draining the caster’s second true body for an extended period.
A fruit of condensed Chaos Force created by a True God or Daofather sacrificing a permanent sliver of their own comprehension of Chaos; a rare and strategically invaluable asset.
